description: NaPrZr₂O₆ is (Cubic) Perovskite-derived structured and crystallizes in the cubic Fm̅3m space group. Na is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.94 Å. Pr is bonded to twelve equivalent O atoms to form PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra that share corners with twelve equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra, faces with six equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with eight equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra. All Pr-O bond lengths are 2.94 Å. Zr is bonded to six equivalent O atoms to form ZrO₆ octahedra that share corners with six equivalent ZrO₆ octahedra, faces with four equivalent NaO₁₂ cuboctahedra, and faces with four equivalent PrO₁₂ cuboctahedra. The corner-sharing octahedra are not tilted. All Zr-O bond lengths are 2.08 Å. O is bonded in a distorted linear geometry to two equivalent Na, two equivalent Pr, and two equivalent Zr atoms.
